D10-183 ② R-01, D10-193 ③: fund metrics read by SQL through new read-only module ports (order_sync_pending open by reason; settle_jobs bill failed; settle_batches PARTIAL; beneficiary shares whose latest event is held and whose first held event is at least 30 x 24 h old per BR-CALC-13; withdrawals PAYING with needs_manual), injected by entry.ts into the worker's collectFund only (platform imports no module; B1-01zzh's collect contract unchanged). Any port failure fails the scrape, no invented zeros; now only from the injected Clock. infra/monitoring/rules/couli-fund.yaml: five alerts with fund="true" and severity. W6 rate, consecutive W6 and the Alipay watermark stay TODO on B2-06a / B2-06fz; other BR-WDR-24 items are payout event alerts. Read-only, no business logic changed, no money moved, no migration.
